verified_points.details: The script consumes actual full50/5294/2-archive closure, exact completed CPU analysis, axis-versus-original both_plus2, positive mAP and Rank-1 versus the paired frequency control, completed selected four-state proof and positive axis11-versus-own00 mAP/Rank-1. The named comparisons and status values match their real writers. State analysis requires both selected11/raw and original00/raw parity records and validates aligned per-query GT metadata; no phase-peak or training status substitutes for acceptance.

Hardcoded G parent3986116 and training3988001/3988002 match the existing original91249 startup record. State controller/NN PIDs are read from the actual state launch files at the paths produced by execute. Remote ps must return1 for every listed PID before launch; live, stopped or zombie PIDs therefore do not count as absent. Existing output/receipt/archive destinations are rejected and the remote launch root is created with exist_ok=False. No replacement observer, training replay, or prior publisher/cleanup is invoked.

Insertion order is MSVR310 then RGBNT100. The first SSH receiver must reach native, controller-complete, two local ACKs/two clear events and wait()==0 before the next dataset begins. The reused controller runs only frequency on physicalGPU2 and axis on physicalGPU3 with two NN workers; native and formal phases are separate. No four-model parallel launch or power/temperature query/control is introduced.

Each dataset runs three real optimizer updates for each model before its formal pair. It rejects AMP skips, unequal strict reload, wrong 8x5120 descriptor, inactive/nonfinite third-step gradients, mismatched capacity or sampled names/partial sets, nonzero effective partial losses, and changed partial forward/BN behavior. Native weights are only serialized in memory and the full stage builds fresh from the original dataset anchor.

verified_points.details: Training uses the full official training split, and extraction uses every official query/gallery record. The selected checkpoint is the first maximum normal mAP epoch among50 and is reloaded/re-evaluated. Installed-filename GT audits verify metadata, complete training coverage, six metrics, CMC1-50, query CSVs and identity/camera/scene groups. Exclusion is same identity/same scene for MSVR310 and same identity/same camera for RGBNT100/RGBNT201, not another model prediction.

D-drive admission is measured, and free space is checked against each announced actual file size before copying. The destination is dataset-specific under the new owned D root. copy_verified requires a fresh destination and matching size/SHA before ACK. Only then does the remote controller recheck containment/size/SHA and unlink the exact raw array. Archives are serialized through one worker; selected best weights, GT text and other datasets remain. One earliest-tie best.pth per formal model is retained; there is no binary Git publication or broad deletion.

Two models each yields14124 formal updates and200 additional epochs; four native3 models yield12 native updates. Only text extensions are packaged; package/member size/SHA validation precedes exact temporary-package removal. It does not start NN, rerun evaluation, transfer arrays/weights or overwrite an existing intake tree.
